run_ppo_trainer: run PPO reinforcement learning training on a causal language model with reward and value models
build_ppo_trainer: build a PPOTrainer with policy, reference, reward, and value models for preference optimization
prepare_dataset_tokenize: prepare a dataset by tokenizing prompts and filtering sequences by maximum length

parse_cli_arguments: parse CLI arguments into ScriptArguments, PPOConfig, and ModelConfig dataclasses
